We have an EPC contract with Bechtel to construct the PA LNG Phase 2 project, which has an estimated price of approximately $10 billion, an increase from $9.2 billion following a change order in October 2026 to include construction costs for a nitrogen rejection unit that was contemplated at FID.

We estimate total capital expenditures for the PA LNG Phase 2 project to remain at approximately $14 billion, including, among other items, project contingency and a $1.9 billion true-up payment to the PA LNG Phase 1 project to acquire a 50% interest in the shared common facilities.
